faqSection.description: Everything you need to know about planning, requesting, and providing event services on Eventies.
faqSection.stillBody: Our team is happy to help you plan your next event.

items.a: Browse service categories, add what you need to a single request, and send it with your event dates. Providers respond with availability and pricing, all tracked from your account.

items.q: What's the difference between rentals and quotes?
items.a: Rental services can be added to your request draft with event dates. Custom services and purchase options are request-based, so the Eventies team reviews details before pricing and next steps are confirmed.

items.q: How do I check availability for my event date?
items.a: Add the services you want and submit a request with your event dates. Availability is reviewed for those exact dates before anything is confirmed.

items.q: Do you cover all of Jordan?
items.a: Yes. Our network of providers operates across Jordan, from Amman to events nationwide. Categories and coverage grow as more providers join.

items.q: How can I list my services as a provider?
items.a: Use the provider request path, share your services, and start receiving qualified requests from event organizers. Listing is free and you manage your own availability.

items.q: How do I get help or support?
items.a: Reach our team anytime through the contact page or our support email. We can help with planning, requests, provider questions, and anything in between.
